title: HB 891 (2023-2024 Regular Session): A Joint Resolution proposing an amendment to the Constitution of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, further providing for qualifications of electors.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Art. VII § 1(b)(1) (as proposed)
(quote) (b) In addition to the qualifications under subsection (a) of this section, a qualified elector shall provide a valid identification at each election in accordance with the following: 1. When voting in person, the qualified elector shall present a valid identification before receiving a ballot to vote in person.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Art. VII § 1(c) (as proposed)
(quote) (c) If a qualified elector does not possess a valid identification, he or she shall, upon request and confirmation of identity, be furnished with a government-issued identification at no cost to the qualified elector.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Art. VII § 1(b)(2) (as proposed)
(quote) 2. When not voting in person, the qualified elector shall provide proof of a valid identification with his or her ballot.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Art. VII § 1(d) (as proposed)
(quote) (d) For purposes of this section, the term "valid identification" means an unexpired government-issued identification, unless otherwise provided for by law.
(section) Section 2 (ballot procedure)
(quote) (2) Upon the second passage by the General Assembly of the amendment, the Secretary of the Commonwealth shall proceed immediately to comply with the advertising requirements of section 1 of Article XI of the Constitution of Pennsylvania.
(other) Section 1 amends Article VII section 1 of the Constitution only; Section 2 sets the advertising and ballot-submission steps for a constitutional amendment.
